mapper.select: SELECT id, title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed) VALUES (#{title}, #{detail}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, COALESCE(#{completed}, false))
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, detail = #{detail}, category = #{category}, priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed = #{completed} WHERE id = #{id}
